# Task Manager Agent — Project Map

> Multi-agent task management using OpenAI Agents SDK, FastMCP, Docker, and K8s.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Start MCP server (development)
cd services/task-mcp && uv run python -m task_manager_mcp

# Build Docker image (MCP)
docker build -t task-mcp:latest -f services/task-mcp/Dockerfile services/task-mcp

# Test MCP tools
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json,text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"tools/list","params":{},"id":1}'

# Deploy to K8s
kubectl apply -f Deployments/k8s/namespace.yaml
kubectl apply -f Deployments/k8s/task-mcp/configmap.yaml
kubectl apply -f Deployments/k8s/task-mcp/service.yaml
kubectl apply -f Deployments/k8s/task-mcp/deployment.yaml
# Then generate + apply secret.yaml from .env
# Then kubectl apply -f Deployments/k8s/task-sandbox-agent/deployment.yaml
```

## Key Documents
- `README.md` — Project overview, milestones, setup
- `AGENTS.md` — Agent workflow, skills, architecture, creator workflow
- `CLAUDE.md` — AI workspace config (`@AGENTS.md`)
- `Progress.md` — Task-level milestone tracking
- `docs/PROJECT_JOURNEY.txt` — Build journey from diagram to working system
- `docs/adrs/agent-decision.md` — ADR-001: Simple Agent vs SandboxAgent
- `docs/adrs/k8s-deployment-decisions.md` — ADR-002: K8s decisions

## Services
- `services/task-mcp/` — MCP server (5 intent-based tools, FastMCP, InMemoryTaskStore)
- `services/task-manager-agent/` — Agent orchestrator (SandboxAgent + CLI)

## Deployment
- `Deployments/k8s/` — K8s manifests (namespace, deployments, service, configmap)
- `.github/workflows/task-mcp-build.yml` — CI for MCP server
- `.github/workflows/task-agent-build.yml` — CI for SandboxAgent

## MCP Tools
- `capture_task` — Create task from natural language
- `review_task` — List, search, filter tasks
- `modify_task` — Update task fields
- `resolve_task` — Mark task completed
- `remove_task` — Delete task permanently

## Container Registry
- `ghcr.io/asifalishaikh/task-manager-agent/task-manager-mcp:master`
- `ghcr.io/asifalishaikh/task-manager-agent/task-sandbox-agent:master`

## K8s (Docker Desktop)
- Namespace: `task-manager`
- MCP: 2 replicas, ClusterIP, port 8000, securityContext enforced
- SandboxAgent: 1 replica, sleep infinity, Docker socket, securityContext
- Internal DNS: `task-mcp-service.task-manager.svc.cluster.local:8000`
